column1: Derived from the PKT Website Content Handoff draft (Phase 1 corporate site). Serves two audiences: freight buyers (shippers/brokers) and drivers (company drivers/owner-operators). Page Goal, Dev Priority and Why This Priority are RECOMMENDATIONS based on the draft's content and CTAs — not stated PKT facts — and should be confirmed before build.

column5: Page Goal
column7: What's on the Page
column10: Why This Priority

column5: Route the two audiences (freight buyers vs. drivers) to their own path within one click; establish credibility for both.
column6: PKT | Asset-Based Truckload Carrier in Illinois
column7: Hero with dual entry paths (freight / drive); proof strip (operating since 2018, 48-state authority); capacity, equipment, coverage, communication and safety sections; primary CTA Request a Quote, secondary Drive With PKT.
column10: Launch-critical — only shared page; both funnels depend on it.

column5: Give freight buyers a hub that frames PKT's asset-based capacity and routes them to the right equipment page.
column7: Asset-based value proposition; how freight moves (book/pickup/transit/delivery); what's needed to quote; coverage and regular lanes; links to every equipment page.
column10: Top of freight funnel; routes to every equipment/service page.

column5: Convert dry van freight demand into a quote request.
column7: 53' dry van capacity, equipment specs (pending), commodity categories hauled, cross-sell notes to reefer/flatbed; quote CTA.
column10: Core revenue equipment line.

column5: Convert temperature-controlled freight demand into a quote request.
column6: Refrigerated Truckload Carrier | PKT Reefer Service
column7: Reefer capabilities, equipment specs (pending), load-protection process, commodity categories, booking requirements; quote CTA.
column10: Core revenue equipment line; higher-stakes freight, less margin for error.

column5: Convert flatbed/open-deck freight demand into a quote request.
column6: Flatbed Carrier and Open Deck Freight | PKT
column7: Flatbed capacity, equipment/securement specs (pending), commodity categories, dimensions/permit guidance, RGN exclusion note; quote CTA.
column10: Core revenue equipment line.

column5: Convert freight too tall for a flatbed into a quote request; help buyers choose flatbed vs. step deck.
column7: Step deck capacity, equipment specs (pending), loading methods, commodity categories, flatbed-vs-step-deck guidance; quote CTA.
column10: Differentiator alongside flatbed; narrower demand than core equipment lines.

column5: Convert consistent, recurring-volume shippers into a dedicated-capacity conversation.
column7: What you get, who it suits, 4-step how-it-works, information needed to scope a program; CTA Talk to Our Team.
column10: High-value recurring offer, but a consideration-stage page rather than top-of-funnel.

column5: Convert shippers with slow or unpredictable loading windows into a drop-trailer-program conversation.
column7: What you get, who it suits, 4-step how-it-works, information needed to scope a program; CTA Talk to Our Team.
column10: Valuable niche program; lower search volume and funnel position than core equipment pages.

column5: Give CDL-A drivers and owner-operators a landing page that routes them to the path that fits them.
column6: Drive for PKT | CDL-A Jobs and Owner-Operator Opportunities
column7: Two paths (company driver / owner-operator) with pay and home-time framing; CTAs to CDL-A Jobs and Lease On.
column10: Top of driver funnel — objective: driver and owner-operator applications.

column5: Convert CDL-A company-driver prospects into open-positions views/applicants.
column7: What PKT provides (truck, trailer, fuel, maintenance, insurance); why drivers stay (dispatch familiarity, available miles, home time, equipment); CTA See Open Positions.
column10: Supports company-driver conversion; sits one step under the driver hub.

column5: Convert owner-operator prospects into lease-on inquiries.
column7: Value proposition (own authority/customer base, steady freight, consistent dispatcher); CTA Lease On.
column10: Supports owner-operator conversion; sits one step under the driver hub.

column5: Let drivers find a matching open role by state and type; anchor for job-page SEO.
column7: Filterable list of current CDL-A company-driver and owner-operator openings; each posting requires JobPosting structured data with an enforced expiry date.
column10: Required careers hub; feeds indexable job postings into Google for Jobs.

column5: Capture a driver application with minimal friction — no resume, no account.
column7: Four-field quick-apply form (name, phone, state, experience, driver type); confirmation message with callback window.
column10: Primary driver conversion point.

column5: Reassure freight buyers on carrier risk and signal quality/compliance to prospective drivers.
column7: Equipment maintenance, driver qualification, hours/fatigue management, cargo securement, compliance/authority details; quote CTA.
column10: Directly answers buyers' #1 evaluation criterion (carrier risk) and reassures driver applicants.

column5: Build trust with both audiences by establishing PKT's story, values and (once available) leadership.
column7: Company story and founding, mission/values statement, leadership section (held pending real names/photos); quote CTA.
column10: Credibility hub referenced by both funnels.

column5: Provide a single, clear way to reach quotes, operations, recruiting and vendors without cross-routing.
column6: Contact PKT | Quotes, Operations and Recruiting
column7: Separate contact routes by audience (freight/quotes, existing customers/ops, driver recruiting, vendors); address, USDOT/MC.
column10: Required utility page; conversion backstop for both funnels.

column5: Anchor the editorial section that builds durable organic visibility over time.
column7: Editorial hub listing articles by topic/audience; publishing workflow for non-technical staff; internal links to services and lanes.
column10: Ongoing content programme; grows organic reach (objective #3).

column5: Rank for high-intent lane searches and funnel to a quote — one of many produced from a template.
column6: Chicago to Dallas Freight | Truckload Capacity | PKT Logistics
column7: Lane-specific content (transit, equipment, typical rate context), quote CTA, rate-estimator link; produced at scale from a template in Phase 4.
column10: Representative of a set of lane pages produced ongoing; SEO growth.

column5: Meet legal/consent obligations for lead capture, analytics and messaging.
column7: Data collection/use, consent for messaging (text/timestamp/source stored), analytics/cookies, contact for data requests. No SSN/DOB/licence/background data collected on site.
column10: Required for launch and consent compliance.

column5: Set site terms and disclaimers (incl. non-binding rate estimates).
column7: Site terms, acceptable use, non-binding-estimate disclaimer, liability, governing law.
column10: Required utility page.

column5: Publish the WCAG 2.1 AA commitment required by the RFP.
column7: WCAG 2.1 AA conformance statement, contact for accessibility issues, audit reference.
column10: Explicitly required deliverable in the RFP.

column5: Recover lost visitors and preserve crawl health after the redirect migration.
column7: Friendly not-found page with search and links to services, drivers and homepage.
column10: Required for redirect/migration hygiene.
